scenes.narration: Walmart keeps only about 4 cents of every dollar you spend. So how does it make more?
In fiscal 2026, Walmart took in 713 billion dollars. Operating income was 29.8 billion. About 280 million people visit each week.
Its advertising business grew 46 percent to nearly 6.4 billion dollars.
Membership and other income added about 6.8 billion more.
Groceries bring people in. Ads and memberships pay extra. Follow for more.
